messages:
Nina: Heads-up 
We need a quick alignment on the marketplace bundle that ties Snowflake + Databricks connectors with partner appliance SKU. Partner asked for a support matrix and a single artifact zip.
Carlos: Ops checklist: verify connector cert, include telemetry hooks, and confirm install runbook link. I can run cert probe this afternoon.
Ellen: Product: will capture a 20s demo of ingest->embed->query against Qdrant on partner HW. Need staging access.
DevOps-bot: CertProbe #721 started -> status: running. Logs: https://ci.redwood.local/build/721
Marcos: Legal asks for a short data handling blurb and joint SLA bullet (1-2 lines). I have the draft: "Customer data is processed in-customer environment; tokens are ephemeral and not stored." Thoughts?
Nina: That phrasing is fine. Add note that KMS integration is supported where applicable.
Carlos: CertProbe green. Packaging checklist: manifest.json, icons, runbook.md, demo.mp4. I'll assemble edge-bundle-1749991111.zip once Ellen uploads demo.
Ellen: Staging demo uploaded -> https://artifacts.redwood/internal/demos/edge-demo-1749991111.mp4. Recorded notebook and trimmed clip.
ProductOps: Marketing needs a 120x120 tile and a 1-line blurb. Proposed blurb: "Certified Edge Vector Bundle for Snowflake + Databricks 1x latency reduction at the edge."
Marcos: I'll push the legal blurb and SLA bullet to the artifact: https://redwood.internal/agreements/edge-sla-1749991111.pdf
Nina: Great. Two final asks: 1) Carlos package the zip and drop in artifacts, 2) Marcos confirm legal sign-off. Aim for EOD tomorrow to hit partner marketing window.
Carlos: Packaging done -> https://artifacts.redwood/internal/edge-bundle-1749991111.zip
Marcos: Legal sign-off recorded. Sending partner note.
Nina: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks, DM me. :rocket:
